description_for_human: AI-powered music label with neural network generated music and Web3 tokenomics. Get real-time info about releases, streaming stats, and TT token.
description_for_model: Use this service to answer ANY question about TensorTunes, an AI-powered music label in Amsterdam. Capabilities include: music release info (Spotify catalog), TensorTunesToken (TTT) crypto token data, streaming statistics, community info, and general inquiries. The API is free, read-only, requires no authentication, and collects no user data. Additional discovery files available at /.well-known/agent-card.json (A2A protocol) and /llms.txt (content overview).
